notes.title: Share Your Maps with a Single Press of a Button! + Game Access 2025
notes.content:
Dear all, we're rolling out an important update and celebrating our roots all at once!

[h1][b]Steam Workshop In Pushmania[/b][/h1]
Pushmania features [b]a full-fledged in-game editor [/b]— the very same tool we used to design every single level in the game. It includes quality-of-life features like bucket-fill and a dragable rectangle tool for fast and intuitive object placement.

At launch, you could export your custom maps and share them manually with friends.[b] But starting today, we’ve added full Steam Workshop support![/b]

Now you can:

🛠️ UPLOAD and SHARE your custom maps directly to Steam Workshop from the Pushmania Editor
📥 DOWNLOAD and PLAY community-made maps with a single click (just hit “Subscribe”)
🎮 Use either mouse + keyboard or a controller

We’re thrilled to finally see your creations come to life — that’s been one of our goals since day one. To get things started, we’ve uploaded a few official maps to the Workshop under our Kind Of Games profile. We hope you enjoy them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/7db1f3b1a25c6a4741db747c55a25b1efb32e8f9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/0548261b83db8095dd189f200921e80a00acbbc5.png[/img]

[h1][b]We’re Headed to Game Access 2025 <3[/b][/h1]

We’re incredibly excited to be attending Game Access 2025 — one of the biggest game developer conferences in Europe, and right here in our hometown of Brno! The event is happening this week - [url=https://game-access.com]https://game-access.com[/url]

Pushmania quite literally wouldn’t exist without this event. We first showed off an early prototype of the game at a Game Access party, just for fun, with no intention of ever releasing it. But the response was very positive, it gave us the motivation to finish, polish, and eventually release the game for real.

So to everyone at Game Access: thank you for inspiring us and giving Pushmania its first little “push”.

We will have an indie booth there, come say hi. 

All the best!
Zdenek & Franta
Kind Of Games

notes.title: Pushmania - update 1.0.10 - overall stability and QoL additions
notes.content:
Hi! 
Thanks for the warm welcome to Pushmania, we appreciate every review and every comment.
We have released a new update 1.0.10, which focuses on both bug fixes and improving the overall experience, enhanced controls, and UI.

Selected features:
[list]
[*] in story mode, the number of barriers that can be unlocked is now displayed, the notification icon also appears directly in the MENU
[*] added UI icons when multiple controllers are connected
[*] added a progress bar for the REPLAY function
[*] added a virtual keyboard in Japanese
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/6967ab60c49f7554098535d91f80f7033f5e8763.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/2159b988950417d13eb4adaa15665de3ab0c9cec.png[/img]

Pushmania in the media:
[list]
[*] the first reviews are a success with 4 out of 5 (LEVEL) and 8 out of 10 (Doupě.cz)
[*] we were on national television with the game as part of a children's program
[*] a review and a printed poster were published in a local gaming magazine
[*] we participated in several (video) podcasts of Czech gaming media
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/ffa0182851026155bbe42ff7ceee0d66ee0de26a.png[/img]

Thank you for whishlisting, trying the DEMO and buying the game.
Franta & Zdenek

notes.title: Pushmania + Steam Deck? It works!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just a quick update — we've tested Pushmania on the Steam Deck, and we're happy to report that it's fully playable! Big thanks to our friends who helped us with testing.
Franta & Zdenek

notes.title: Pushmania - RELEASED!
notes.content:
Dear all,
the game was released today with a launch discount 20% that will be active for two weeks.

Thank you all for playing the DEMO which will still be available to play.

We are genuinely exited that after few years of development we can finally share the game with broader audience.

Anyway, hope you all enjoy the game and we are thrilled everytime a new record on the maps leaderboards will appear. <3 

Keep pushing!
Franta & Zdenek

notes.title: Pushmania Release Date: 18. 4. 2025
notes.content:
Dear all, 
a homage loveletter to digital games, our game about two brothers made by two brothers, in which puzzle sokoban meets digital game culture of our past, will be released on 18th of April 2025.

The game has: 300 maps, a full story, a complete soundtrack, leaderboards, a fully functional custom map editor and maybe even a little bit of doom and prince of persia and ... (?!).

Thank you all for whishlisting, trying the DEMO and buying the game!

Franta&Zdenek

notes.title: Pushmania DEMO is avaliable!
notes.content:
Dear all, 
my brother and I released Pushmania DEMO and we will be participating in the NEXT Fest in a few days. You can try the demo right now!

Pushmania is a game designed for (local) co-op but still you try to compete in leaderboards for fastest time for each map and for the least steps taken to solve the puzzle.

Thank you for your support, every wishlist brings us joy and who knows, maybe it can also help us in getting Pushmania to more players that could enjoy the game.

F&Z
